section.61: Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions

61.name_native: Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions

hadiths.text: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to dye (his) hair?" He said, "No, for there were only a few white hairs on his temples
